title: NLU Meghalaya appoints Prof Jyoti Mozika as Vice-Chancellor
description: Prof Jyoti Mozika, Head of the Department of Law, North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU), has been appointed Vice-Chancellor of the National Law University Meghalaya (NLU Meg).Prof Mozika is expected to take charge in August. The post has been vacant since the retirement of NLU Meghalaya's founding Vice-Chancellor, Prof Indrajit Dube, in February. Founding Registrar Kerpa Meida Lyngdoh Nongbri has been serving as Vice-Chancellor in-charge in the interim.Prof Mozika brings over 27 years of teaching
